name: output-page-ground-start

graded_by.test: owed by the E2 core plan (pages land at E5)

description: A page starts where the core's VT parser was at ground (C1 decision 3; 5.48; C4 decision 8; F15). At most max_bytes, unless no ground start lies within, in which case the page goes back to the nearest one, bounded by the page-cap knob; when no ground start lies within the cap the body is empty, no first/last seq headers are sent, TSB-Page-No-Ground is true and TSB-Page-Next-Before-Seq carries the seq to continue from — an explicit false end-of-history is never sent. Published e2 so the web lane may build against it; required green at e5, where a core ring first exists (no core ring at E2). The live shape is graded by U2, owed by the E2 core plan.
